summaryJa: 電話でFBI特別捜査官に面接され、被面接者は2026年の特定されていない日付に偵察目的で出発した際の目撃内容を報告した。ゲート到着時に雨が強かったため待機し、その後ゲートを開け北へ移動。約2200頃、約25マイル走行した地点で西の山稜の頂に赤い光を見つけて停車し確認した。光は当初山の何かかと思われたが東へ移動し、山稜の標高約5000フィート、雲底約7000フィートを基に地上高度で5000～7000フィート付近を移動していると被面接者は推定した。約15分後、さらに6～10個ほどの赤い光が真上に現れ、最初の光と同期するように東～南東へ移動した。うち1つは急速に（約1000フィート）降下して消え、他の光も東～南東へ移動して消えた。光は赤色で、初見および夜間光学装置越しでは単一点に見えたが、詳細観察に関する記述は文書で途切れている。文書にはFBIによる勧告や結論は含まれていない。
summaryEn: Interviewed by an FBI Special Agent via telephone, the subject provided an account of an observation during an area reconnaissance trip on unspecified dates in 2026. After arriving at a gate in heavy rain and waiting for it to subside, they unlocked the gate and drove north. At approximately 2200, after about 25 miles, they noticed a red light at the crest of the mountain range to their west and pulled over. Initially thought to be on the mountain, the light moved east; given a mountain elevation of about 5,000 ft and a cloud base of about 7,000 ft, the subject estimated the light was between 5,000 and 7,000 ft AGL. After roughly 15 minutes, an additional approximately 6–10 lights appeared directly overhead; these lights appeared to 'sync up' with the first and traveled east/southeast. One light descended rapidly (estimated ~1,000 ft) and disappeared; the others continued east/southeast and also disappeared. The lights were described as red and appeared as single points both to the naked eye and through Night Optical Devices, with further observation details truncated in the document. The report contains no FBI recommendations or conclusions.
